🔔 Price Alert Guide

Create a price alert using the following format:

/alert <coin> <operator> <price>

Examples:
• /alert btc > 70000
• /alert eth < 1800
• /alert sol > 200

Supported coins: BTC, ETH, SOL

You'll receive a notification as soon as your target price is reached. 🚀

If you want to view or delete your alerts, type /myalerts.

❌ You already have 3 active alerts.

Delete one before creating another.

👋 *Welcome to Crypto Intelligence Bot!*

Your personal AI-powered crypto assistant.

With this bot you can quickly check cryptocurrency prices and receive daily market insights.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📌 *Available Commands*

💰 `/price btc`
Get the current price and 24h change for Bitcoin.

You can also use:
• `/price eth`
• `/price sol`

☀️ `/digest`
Receive the latest crypto market digest instantly, including:
• BTC, ETH & SOL prices
• 24h market performance
• Market overview

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🚀 More features are coming soon:
• 🔔 Price Alerts
• ⭐ Watchlist
• 📰 AI News Digest
• 😱 Fear & Greed Index
• 📅 Economic Calendar
• 🤖 AI Market Analysis
• 📈 Portfolio Tracker

Happy trading! 📈
